verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show a full REST API for Treasury covering financial accounts, transactions/ledger entries, received debits, outbound payments, and balances (docs-16,19,10,11,13), and a probe confirms an official Stripe MCP server exists (probe-4). However, there's no evidence the MCP surface specifically exposes Treasury banking data (vs. just Payments/Billing), and no documented endpoint for 'documents' (statements, tax docs) within Treasury. Missing for 10: explicit document/statement retrieval API, confirmation that the official MCP server surfaces Treasury-specific objects, and independent/hands-on corroboration of agentic read access.
